topics.label: Introduction and lecture learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumor cells evolve through stepwise genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations that confer selective growth advantages.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the relationship between normal tissue hierarchies and cancer development, presenting evidence for how stemness and cell of origin influence tumor initiation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental signals and inflammation in tumor promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and stromal support from the microenvironment act as essential non-mutagenic promoters of tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational approaches to investigate tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the single-cell sequencing, spatial profiling, and computational methods used to study cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental mechanisms into a comprehensive evolutionary framework of cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
